baseline: B00: prior-only 250-observation high/low breakout with EWMA alpha=0.25
DM-20260924-11: original BOX_RIDGE_001 Phase 1 signal-path diagnostic
conditional_trigger: Original box_duration median=5 and 87.2% of qualified high-event boxes have L<=10; perform the one authorized sqrt(L) correction retest.

walk_forward_folds.role: Jan-Mar partial; report separately; previously seen Train

confirmation_policy.purpose: single conditional feature-definition retest and Phase 1 diagnostics

feature_definitions.box_duration: Largest L in {5,10,...,120} with prior-only (HighMax-LowMin)/(ATR20_prior*sqrt(L)) < 3; window ends at t-1.
feature_definitions.box_width_atr: Selected prior box width divided by prior ATR20.
feature_definitions.close_position: Prior close position inside the selected prior-only box.
feature_definitions.distance_to_prior_high: Prior close divided by high maximum over observations t-251 through t-2, minus one.
feature_definitions.event: Close[t] exceeds prior 250-observation High, with 250-row history available.
feature_definitions.breakout_volume_ratio_diagnostic: Raw Volume[t] in common share units divided by prior 20-observation median ending t-1; event-only univariate diagnostic.
feature_definitions.upper_touch_density_diagnostic: Among selected sqrt(L) box observations ending t-1, share with High within 1% of selected Upper; event-only diagnostic.
feature_definitions.timing_diagnostics: Compare t-1 box features with fixed-definition features through t Close; diagnostic only.
feature_definitions.matched_control: A = high event and corrected box_duration>0; B = same-date B00 high-event set excluding A; daily equal-weight paired outcomes.

model: Annual expanding Ridge lambda=1.0, same five feature columns and centered daily target ranks, high-breakout training rows only; rerun once with the corrected duration definition. No model family or target-horizon alternatives.

parameters.short_signal: preserve B00 score for all ablations

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive event-only RankIC/quintile and score-to-weight-to-Net transmission; no candidate selection or adoption.
